name: verl
summary: Distributed reinforcement-learning training library for LLMs, with GRPO/PPO dataflows and pluggable training and rollout engines for agentic post-training.
description: Open-source implementation of HybridFlow, initiated by ByteDance Seed and maintained by the verl community. PyPI verl 0.9.1 supports Python 3.10–3.12; follow the repository installation guide for compatible GPU and engine dependencies. Integrates FSDP, Megatron-LM, vLLM and SGLang, including multi-turn agentic rollouts. Recipes moved to verl-project/verl-recipe and specify compatible revisions. Apache-2.0 software; GPU resources are not included.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
